message: field access `.v` is unsafe on `T`: the type has a nullary constructor, so a value may be an immediate tag with no fields to read
label: the value may not be a block at all
notes: an unguarded load on an immediate dereferences a small integer: this passed `check` and died of SIGSEGV (docs/memory-model.md MM-VAL-9a)
help: match on the value instead, and read the field in the fieldful arm - a `match` emits the immediate-or-address guard that field access cannot
